hooks.name: URRC-000001 Repository Reality Gate
hooks.description: Runs the URRC-000001 Repository Reality Gate at session start, so the repository-reality posture is surfaced from Repository Truth: how many chartered deliverables are bound, how much declared substrate is usable, how many derivations were measured, how many gates passed, how many facts are declared non-derivable, the gate outcome and the seal. The programme creates no catalogue, registry, roadmap, graph, sequence or authority: it binds canonical owners by pointer, derives what has no owner, and declares verified absence with a counted probe rather than filling it in. Deterministic, stdlib-only, non-blocking at session start; fail-closed as a gate. AUTHORITY = NONE (DERIVED TRUTH).
